failure_cluster: Full-edge, repeated-temperature dense feature construction exceeds the fixed 4-GiB address-space budget. At 384 states, its concatenate operation alone requests about 2.2 GiB while prior full feature arrays remain live.
new_generation: 384-448 states, 6-8 phonon branches, ten temperatures; same reciprocal collision model, same observables, same 80/70 quality target, same 90-second and 4-GiB case limits.
scientific_rationale: A transferable event coreset must remain useful as the Fermi-surface catalogue grows. The original champion is accurate across 26 independent small/medium cases; its failure is operator representation and constrained-fit scalability, not hidden identifiers or altered physical equations.
